name: Factory Overheads
expr: Factory Overheads = Indirect Material + Indirect Labour + Indirect Factory Expenses

name: Total Manufacturing Cost
expr: Total Manufacturing Cost = Direct Material Used + Direct Labour + Factory Overheads

name: Cost of Goods Available for Sale
expr: Goods Available for Sale = Opening Finished Goods + Cost of Goods Manufactured

name: Cost of Sales
expr: Cost of Sales = Cost of Production + Opening Finished Goods − Closing Finished Goods + Selling & Distribution Overheads

name: Sales from Cost Sheet
expr: Sales = Cost of Sales + Profit

name: Profit Percentage on Sales
expr: Profit % on Sales = (Profit/Sales) × 100

name: Conversion Cost
expr: Conversion Cost = Direct Labour + Factory Overheads

name: Direct Materials Used
expr: Direct Materials Used = Opening Raw Materials + Purchases − Closing Raw Materials

name: Least Squares Variable Cost (b)
expr: b = (nΣxy − ΣxΣy)/(nΣx² − (Σx)²)

name: Least Squares Fixed Cost (a)
expr: a = (Σy − bΣx)/n

name: Scattergraph Cost Line
expr: Total Cost = a + b × Activity Level

name: Semi-Variable Cost Split
expr: Semi-Variable Cost = Fixed Element + (Variable Rate × Activity)

name: Total Cost per Unit at Different Volumes
expr: Total Cost per Unit = (Fixed Cost/Units) + Variable Cost per Unit

name: Fixed Cost per Unit
expr: Fixed Cost per Unit = Total Fixed Cost/Units Produced

name: Cost of Materials Purchased
expr: Material Cost = Invoice Price + Freight + Insurance + Import Duty + Handling − Trade Discount

name: Materials Consumed
expr: Materials Consumed = Opening Stock + Purchases − Closing Stock

name: Annual Ordering Cost
expr: Annual Ordering Cost = (D/Q) × S, D = annual demand, Q = order size, S = cost per order

name: Annual Holding Cost
expr: Annual Holding Cost = (Q/2) × H, H = holding cost per unit per year

name: EOQ (Holding Cost as % of Price)
expr: EOQ = √(2DS/(i × P)), i = holding cost %, P = unit price

name: Number of Orders per Year
expr: N = D/EOQ

name: Order Cycle (Days)
expr: Order Cycle = (EOQ/D) × 365

name: Economic Production Quantity (EPQ)
expr: EPQ = √(2DS/(H(1 − d/p))), d = daily usage, p = daily production rate

name: Maximum Inventory (EPQ Model)
expr: Maximum Inventory = EPQ × (1 − d/p)

name: Average Inventory (EOQ Model)
expr: Average Inventory = Q/2

name: Reorder Level with Safety Stock
expr: ROL = (Average Daily Usage × Average Lead Time) + Safety Stock

name: Average Stock Level (Reorder Quantity)
expr: Average Stock = Minimum Stock + ½ × Reorder Quantity

name: Danger Level
expr: Danger Level = Average Daily Consumption × Emergency Lead Time

name: Total Cost with Quantity Discount
expr: TC = (D/Q)S + (Q/2)H + D × P, P = discounted price

name: Material Turnover Ratio
expr: Material Turnover = Cost of Materials Consumed/Average Stock

name: Material Holding Period (Days)
expr: Holding Period = 365/Material Turnover Ratio

name: Simple Average Issue Price
expr: Issue Price = Sum of Prices of Lots in Stock/Number of Lots

name: Annual Usage Value (ABC Analysis)
expr: Usage Value = Annual Units Consumed × Unit Cost

name: ABC Value Share
expr: Value Share % = (Item Usage Value/Total Usage Value) × 100

name: Material Wastage Percentage
expr: Wastage % = (Quantity Wasted/Quantity Input) × 100

name: Net Material Cost
expr: Net Material Cost = Gross Material Cost − Scrap Realisable Value

name: Closing Stock (Stores Ledger)
expr: Closing Stock = Opening Stock + Receipts − Issues

name: Material Price Variance (Purchase Basis)
expr: MPV = (Standard Price − Actual Price) × Actual Quantity Purchased

name: Inventory Carrying Cost Rate
expr: Carrying Cost % = (Total Carrying Cost/Average Inventory Value) × 100

name: Lead Time Demand
expr: Lead Time Demand = Daily Demand × Lead Time (days)

name: Safety Stock (Service Level)
expr: Safety Stock = Z × σ of Lead Time Demand

name: Reorder Point (Probabilistic)
expr: ROP = Lead Time Demand + Safety Stock

name: Time Wage
expr: Wages = Hours Worked × Hourly Rate

name: Piece Rate Wage
expr: Wages = Units Produced × Rate per Piece

name: Taylor Differential Piece Rate
expr: Efficient (output ≥ standard): Units × Higher Rate (about 120%–125% of normal); Inefficient: Units × Lower Rate (about 80%–83%)

name: Merrick Multiple Piece Rate
expr: Up to 83% of standard: Normal Rate; 83%–100%: 110% of Normal Rate; above 100%: 120% of Normal Rate

name: Gantt Task Bonus Plan
expr: Below standard: Guaranteed Time Wage; At or above standard: 120% × Piece Rate × Output

name: Emerson Efficiency Bonus
expr: No bonus below 66⅔% efficiency; bonus rises to 20% at 100%; above 100%: 20% + 1% for each 1% above standard

name: Barth Sharing Plan
expr: Earnings = Rate × √(Standard Hours × Hours Worked)

name: Time Saved
expr: Time Saved = Standard Time − Actual Time

name: Idle Time Ratio
expr: Idle Time % = (Idle Hours/Total Paid Hours) × 100

name: Overtime Wages
expr: Overtime Wages = Overtime Hours × Hourly Rate × (1 + Premium Rate)

name: Labour Cost per Unit
expr: Labour Cost per Unit = Total Direct Labour Cost/Units Produced

name: Labour Turnover (Separation Method)
expr: LTO % = (Separations/Average Number of Workers) × 100

name: Labour Turnover (Replacement Method)
expr: LTO % = (Replacements/Average Number of Workers) × 100

name: Labour Turnover (Flux Method)
expr: Flux Rate = (Separations + Accessions)/Average Number of Workers × 100

name: Cost of Labour Turnover
expr: Cost = Separation Cost + Recruitment & Training Cost + Lost Production Cost

name: Effective Hourly Rate (with Fringe Benefits)
expr: Effective Rate = (Wages + Fringe Benefits)/Productive Hours

name: Productive Hours
expr: Productive Hours = Hours Paid − Idle Hours

name: Direct Labour Hour Rate
expr: Labour Hour Rate = Direct Wages/Direct Labour Hours

name: Guaranteed Minimum Piece Earnings
expr: Earnings = Higher of (Guaranteed Time Wage, Output × Piece Rate)

name: Labour Mix Variance
expr: Mix Variance = (Actual Hours in Standard Mix − Actual Hours Worked) × Standard Rate

name: Labour Yield Variance
expr: Yield Variance = (Actual Yield − Standard Yield for Actual Input) × Standard Labour Cost per Unit of Output

name: Apportionment by Floor Area
expr: Dept Share = (Dept Floor Area/Total Floor Area) × Rent

name: Apportionment by Light Points
expr: Dept Share = (Dept Light Points/Total Light Points) × Lighting Cost

name: Apportionment by Capital Value
expr: Dept Share = (Dept Asset Value/Total Asset Value) × Depreciation

name: Apportionment by Number of Workers
expr: Dept Share = (Dept Workers/Total Workers) × Welfare Cost

name: Direct Redistribution of Service Costs
expr: Production Dept OH = Own OH + Σ (Service Dept Cost × Usage %)

name: Step Method Reapportionment
expr: Cost of Next Service Dept = Own OH + Share Received from Earlier Service Dept

name: Reciprocal Method Equations
expr: S₁ = OH₁ + a × S₂ and S₂ = OH₂ + b × S₁, a and b = % of each service dept used by the other

name: Overhead Rate per Direct Labour Hour
expr: OH Rate = Budgeted OH/Budgeted Direct Labour Hours

name: Overhead Rate as % of Direct Wages
expr: OH Rate % = (Budgeted OH/Budgeted Direct Wages) × 100

name: Overhead Rate as % of Prime Cost
expr: OH Rate % = (Budgeted OH/Budgeted Prime Cost) × 100

name: Overhead Rate as % of Direct Material
expr: OH Rate % = (Budgeted OH/Direct Material Cost) × 100

name: Overhead Rate per Unit
expr: OH per Unit = Budgeted OH/Budgeted Units

name: Supplementary Overhead Rate
expr: Supplementary Rate = Under- or Over-absorbed OH/Actual Base Quantity

name: Fixed Overhead Rate (Normal Capacity)
expr: Fixed OH Rate = Budgeted Fixed OH/Normal Capacity

name: Absorbed Overhead
expr: Absorbed OH = OH Rate × Actual Base Quantity

name: Total Departmental Overhead
expr: Departmental OH = Allocated OH + Apportioned OH + Reapportioned Service Dept OH

name: Cost of Unused Capacity
expr: Unused Capacity Cost = Fixed OH Rate × (Normal Capacity − Actual Capacity)

name: Selling Overhead Rate
expr: Selling OH % = (Selling OH/Sales) × 100

name: Distribution Cost per Unit
expr: Distribution Cost per Unit = Total Distribution OH/Units Sold

name: Administration Overhead on Factory Cost
expr: Admin OH % = (Admin OH/Factory Cost) × 100

name: Maintenance Cost per Machine Hour
expr: Maintenance Cost per Hour = Total Maintenance Cost/Machine Hours

name: Depreciation per Machine Hour
expr: Depreciation per Hour = (Cost − Salvage Value)/Estimated Life in Machine Hours

name: Total Job Cost
expr: Job Cost = Direct Material + Direct Labour + Direct Expenses + Absorbed OH

name: Job Price (Markup on Cost)
expr: Price = Job Cost × (1 + Markup %)

name: Job Price (Margin on Sales)
expr: Price = Job Cost/(1 − Margin %)

name: Batch Cost per Unit
expr: Cost per Unit = Total Batch Cost/Units in Batch

name: Economic Batch Quantity (EBQ)
expr: EBQ = √(2DS/C), S = setup cost per batch, C = carrying cost per unit

name: Batch Setup Cost per Unit
expr: Setup Cost per Unit = Setup Cost per Batch/Batch Size

name: Total Cost of Batch Run
expr: Batch Cost = Setup Cost + (Variable Cost per Unit × Batch Size)

name: Job Overhead
expr: Job OH = OH Rate × Job Base Quantity

name: Job Cost Variance
expr: Job Cost Variance = Budgeted Job Cost − Actual Job Cost

name: Abnormal Spoilage Cost (Job)
expr: Abnormal Spoilage Cost = Spoiled Units × Cost per Unit − Scrap Value

name: Contract Profit (Completed)
expr: Profit = Contract Price − Total Contract Cost

name: Retention Money
expr: Retention = Work Certified × Retention %

name: Cash Received on Contract
expr: Cash Received = Work Certified − Retention Money

name: Estimated Contract Profit
expr: Estimated Profit = Contract Price − (Cost to Date + Estimated Cost to Complete)

name: Profit Credited (Under 25% Complete)
expr: Profit Credited = Nil

name: Profit Credited (25%–50% Complete)
expr: Profit Credited = ⅓ × Notional Profit × (Cash Received/Work Certified)

name: Profit Credited (50% or More Complete)
expr: Profit Credited = ⅔ × Notional Profit × (Cash Received/Work Certified)

name: Profit Credited (Nearly Complete)
expr: Profit Credited = Estimated Total Profit × (Work Certified/Contract Price)

name: Percentage of Completion (Cost Basis)
expr: % Complete = (Cost Incurred to Date/Total Estimated Cost) × 100

name: Revenue Recognised Over Time
expr: Revenue to Date = Contract Price × % Complete

name: Amount Due from Customers (Contract)
expr: Amount Due = Cost Incurred + Recognised Profit − Progress Billings

name: Contract Escalation Claim
expr: Escalation = Base Quantity × (Current Price − Base Price)

name: Plant Depreciation on Contract
expr: Plant Depreciation = (Cost − Residual Value)/Life × Period Used

name: Provision for Foreseeable Contract Loss
expr: Provision = Total Expected Loss − Loss Already Recognised

name: Cost-Plus Fixed Fee Contract
expr: Contract Price = Actual Cost + Fixed Fee

name: Incentive Contract Fee
expr: Fee = Target Fee + Sharing % × (Target Cost − Actual Cost)

name: Normal Loss Units
expr: Normal Loss = Input × Normal Loss %

name: Abnormal Loss Units
expr: Abnormal Loss = Actual Loss − Normal Loss

name: Abnormal Gain Units
expr: Abnormal Gain = Normal Loss − Actual Loss

name: Good Output Units
expr: Good Output = Input − Total Actual Loss

name: Value of Normal Loss (Scrap)
expr: Normal Loss Value = Normal Loss Units × Scrap Value per Unit

name: Process Cost per Unit (with Normal Loss)
expr: Cost per Unit = (Total Process Cost − Scrap Value of Normal Loss)/(Input − Normal Loss Units)

name: Value of Abnormal Loss
expr: Abnormal Loss Value = Abnormal Loss Units × Cost per Unit

name: Value of Abnormal Gain
expr: Abnormal Gain Value = Abnormal Gain Units × Cost per Unit

name: Equivalent Units (FIFO)
expr: EU (FIFO) = Opening WIP × % Remaining + Units Started and Completed + Closing WIP × % Complete

name: Equivalent Units (Weighted Average)
expr: EU (WA) = Units Completed and Transferred + Closing WIP × % Complete

name: Cost per Equivalent Unit (Weighted Average)
expr: Cost per EU = (Opening WIP Cost + Current Period Cost)/EU (Weighted Average)

name: Cost per Equivalent Unit (FIFO)
expr: Cost per EU = Current Period Cost/EU (FIFO)

name: Cost of Units Transferred Out
expr: Transferred Cost = Units Transferred × Cost per EU

name: Closing WIP Valuation
expr: Closing WIP = Closing WIP EU × Cost per EU, for each cost element

name: Units to Account For
expr: Units to Account For = Opening WIP Units + Units Started

name: Units Accounted For
expr: Units Accounted For = Completed + Closing WIP + Lost Units

name: Costs to Account For
expr: Costs to Account For = Opening WIP Cost + Costs Added During Period

name: Transferred-In Cost per Unit
expr: Transferred-in Cost per Unit = Cost Transferred from Previous Process/Units Received

name: Inter-Process Profit
expr: Inter-process Profit = Transfer Price − Cost of Transferred Units

name: Unrealised Profit in Closing Stock
expr: Unrealised Profit = Closing Stock Value × (Profit/Transfer Price)

name: Process Yield Percentage
expr: Yield % = (Good Output/Input) × 100

name: Process Loss Percentage
expr: Loss % = (Loss/Input) × 100

name: Total Cost per Equivalent Unit
expr: Total Cost per EU = Material Cost per EU + Conversion Cost per EU

name: Joint Cost: Physical Units Method
expr: Joint Cost Allocated = (Product Units/Total Units) × Total Joint Cost

name: Joint Cost: Sales Value at Split-off
expr: Joint Cost Allocated = (Product Sales Value at Split-off/Total Sales Value at Split-off) × Joint Cost

name: Hypothetical NRV at Split-off
expr: NRV at Split-off = Final Sales Value − Separable Costs After Split-off

name: Joint Cost: Constant Gross Margin %
expr: Joint Cost Allocated = Product Final Sales − Product Separable Cost − (Product Final Sales × Overall GM %)

name: Joint Cost per Unit
expr: Joint Cost per Unit = Total Joint Cost/Total Units

name: By-Product Revenue as Other Income
expr: Other Income = By-Product Sales Revenue

name: Net Joint Cost After By-Product Credit
expr: Net Joint Cost = Total Joint Cost − By-Product NRV

name: By-Product Net Realisable Value
expr: By-Product NRV = Sales Value − Separable Cost − Selling Cost

name: Incremental Profit from Further Processing
expr: Incremental Profit = (Final Sales − Sales at Split-off) − Additional Processing Cost

name: Sell or Process Further Rule
expr: Process Further if Incremental Revenue > Incremental Processing Cost

name: Weighted Units Method
expr: Share = (Physical Units × Weight)/Σ (Physical Units × Weight) × Joint Cost

name: Gross Margin per Joint Product
expr: Gross Margin = Sales − Allocated Joint Cost − Separable Cost

name: Gross Margin Percentage per Product
expr: GM % = ((Sales − Total Cost)/Sales) × 100

name: Profit under Marginal Costing
expr: Profit = Total Contribution − Fixed Costs

name: Contribution per Unit
expr: Contribution per Unit = Selling Price − Variable Cost per Unit

name: Total Contribution
expr: Total Contribution = Contribution per Unit × Units Sold

name: Profit under Absorption Costing
expr: Profit = Sales − Absorption Cost of Goods Sold − Non-manufacturing Costs

name: Absorption Cost per Unit
expr: Absorption Cost per Unit = Variable Cost per Unit + Fixed Production OH per Unit

name: Fixed Production OH per Unit
expr: Fixed OH per Unit = Budgeted Fixed Production OH/Normal Production Units

name: Profit Difference: Absorption vs Marginal
expr: Difference = (Closing Stock Units − Opening Stock Units) × Fixed OH per Unit

name: Profit Reconciliation (Absorption)
expr: Absorption Profit = Marginal Profit + (Closing Stock − Opening Stock) × Fixed OH Rate

name: Closing Stock Value (Marginal Costing)
expr: Closing Stock = Units × Variable Cost per Unit

name: Closing Stock Value (Absorption Costing)
expr: Closing Stock = Units × (Variable Cost + Fixed OH per Unit)

name: Fixed OH Deferred in Closing Stock
expr: Fixed OH Deferred = Unsold Units × Fixed OH per Unit

name: Shutdown Point (Units)
expr: Shutdown Point = Avoidable Fixed Costs/Contribution per Unit

name: Indifference Point
expr: Indifference Point = (Fixed Cost₂ − Fixed Cost₁)/(Variable Cost₁ − Variable Cost₂ per unit)

name: Cash Break-even Point (Units)
expr: Cash BEP = (Fixed Costs − Non-cash Fixed Costs)/Contribution per Unit

name: Absorption Cost Pricing
expr: Price = Absorption Cost per Unit × (1 + Markup %)

name: Minimum Price (Variable Cost Floor)
expr: Minimum Price = Variable Cost per Unit

name: Required Sales Units for Target After-Tax Profit
expr: Units = (Fixed Costs + Target Net Income/(1 − Tax Rate))/Contribution per Unit

name: Margin of Safety (Units)
expr: MoS Units = Actual Units − Break-even Units

name: Margin of Safety from Profit
expr: MoS Sales = Profit ÷ (P/V Ratio)

name: Profit from Sales and P/V Ratio
expr: Profit = (Sales × P/V Ratio) − Fixed Costs

name: Break-even Units after Price Change
expr: New BEP = Fixed Costs/(New Price − Variable Cost per Unit)

name: Break-even after Fixed Cost Change
expr: New BEP = (Fixed Costs ± ΔFC)/Contribution per Unit

name: Break-even after Variable Cost Change
expr: New BEP = Fixed Costs/(Price − (Variable Cost ± ΔVC))

name: Profit Change from Operating Leverage
expr: % Change in Profit = DOL × % Change in Sales

name: Degree of Total Leverage
expr: DTL = DOL × DFL

name: Sales for Target Profit as % of Sales
expr: Required Sales = Fixed Costs/(P/V Ratio − Target Profit %)

name: Variable Cost Ratio
expr: Variable Cost Ratio = Variable Costs/Sales = 1 − P/V Ratio

name: Cash Break-even Sales
expr: Cash BE Sales = (Fixed Costs − Depreciation)/P/V Ratio

name: Change in Operating Income
expr: Δ Operating Income = Δ Units × Contribution per Unit

name: Volume Needed after Price Cut (Same Contribution)
expr: New Volume = Old Volume × Contribution per Unit/(Contribution per Unit − Price Cut)

name: Standard Cost per Unit
expr: Standard Cost per Unit = Std Material + Std Labour + Std Variable OH + Std Fixed OH

name: Standard Quantity Allowed
expr: Standard Quantity Allowed = Actual Output × Standard Quantity per Unit

name: Standard Hours Allowed
expr: Standard Hours = Actual Output × Standard Hours per Unit

name: Material Price Variance (Usage Basis)
expr: MPV = (Standard Price − Actual Price) × Actual Quantity Used

name: Fixed Overhead Calendar Variance
expr: Calendar Variance = (Actual Days − Budgeted Days) × Standard Fixed OH per Day

name: Fixed Overhead Efficiency Variance
expr: Efficiency Variance = (Std Hours for Actual Output − Actual Hours) × Std Fixed OH Rate per Hour

name: Sales Margin Volume Variance
expr: Sales Margin Volume Variance = (Actual Units − Budgeted Units) × Standard Profit per Unit

name: Sales Margin Mix Variance
expr: Mix Variance = Σ (Actual Units − Actual Total Units × Budget Mix %) × Standard Margin per Unit

name: Sales Margin Quantity Variance
expr: Quantity Variance = (Actual Total Units × Budget Mix − Budgeted Units) × Standard Margin

name: Total Sales Margin Variance
expr: Total Sales Margin Variance = Actual Profit − Budgeted Profit

name: Material Cost Variance Check
expr: Material Cost Variance = Price Variance + Usage Variance

name: Labour Cost Variance Check
expr: LCV = Rate Variance + Efficiency Variance + Idle Time Variance

name: Variable OH Variance Check
expr: VOH Variance = Expenditure Variance + Efficiency Variance

name: Fixed OH Volume Variance Breakdown
expr: Volume Variance = Capacity Variance + Calendar Variance + Efficiency Variance

name: Variance as % of Standard
expr: Variance % = (Variance/Standard Cost) × 100

name: Planning Variance
expr: Planning Variance = (Original Standard − Revised Standard) × Actual Quantity

name: Operating Variance
expr: Operating Variance = (Revised Standard − Actual) × Actual Quantity

name: Calendar Ratio
expr: Calendar Ratio = (Actual Working Days/Budgeted Working Days) × 100

name: Sales Budget Revenue
expr: Budgeted Sales Revenue = Budgeted Units × Budgeted Price

name: Direct Material Usage Budget
expr: Material Required = Budgeted Production × Material per Unit

name: Direct Material Purchases Budget (Quantity)
expr: Purchases = Required for Production + Closing Stock − Opening Stock

name: Direct Labour Budget
expr: Labour Cost = Budgeted Production × Hours per Unit × Rate per Hour

name: Overhead Budget
expr: Budgeted OH = Fixed OH + (Variable OH Rate × Activity)

name: Cost of Goods Sold Budget
expr: COGS Budget = Opening Finished Goods + Production Cost − Closing Finished Goods

name: Cash Receipts from Credit Sales
expr: Receipts = Σ (Credit Sales of Month × Collection %)

name: Cash Payments to Creditors
expr: Payments = Purchases of Earlier Month × Payment %

name: Opening Cash for Next Period
expr: Opening Cash (Next) = Closing Cash (Current)

name: Net Cash Flow (Cash Budget)
expr: Net Cash Flow = Total Receipts − Total Payments

name: Master Budget Net Profit
expr: Budgeted Net Profit = Sales − COGS − Operating Expenses − Interest − Tax

name: Flexed Budget Cost
expr: Flexed Cost = Fixed Cost + (Variable Cost per Unit × Actual Activity)

name: Sales Volume Variance (Budget)
expr: Volume Variance = Flexed Budget − Original Budget

name: Incremental Budget
expr: New Budget = Previous Budget × (1 + Growth %)

name: Budget Cost Allowance
expr: Budget Cost Allowance = Fixed Element + (Variable Rate × Actual Activity)

name: Budgeted Closing Receivables
expr: Closing Receivables = Credit Sales × (Debtor Days/365)

name: Budgeted Closing Payables
expr: Closing Payables = Credit Purchases × (Creditor Days/365)

name: Cost Driver Rate
expr: Cost Driver Rate = Total Cost of Activity Pool/Total Cost Driver Volume

name: Overhead Assigned to Product (ABC)
expr: ABC Overhead = Σ (Driver Rate × Driver Units Used by Product)

name: ABC Cost per Unit
expr: ABC Unit Cost = (Direct Costs + Σ Activity Cost Assigned)/Units Produced

name: Cost per Setup
expr: Cost per Setup = Total Setup Cost/Number of Setups

name: Cost per Purchase Order
expr: Cost per Order = Purchasing Dept Cost/Number of Orders

name: Cost per Inspection
expr: Cost per Inspection = Inspection Cost/Number of Inspections

name: Cost per Material Move
expr: Cost per Move = Handling Cost/Number of Moves

name: Customer Cost to Serve
expr: Cost to Serve = Σ Activity Costs Used by Customer

name: Customer Profitability
expr: Customer Profit = Revenue − Cost of Goods − Cost to Serve

name: Product Profitability (ABC)
expr: Product Profit = Sales − Direct Costs − ABC Overhead

name: Costing Distortion (ABC vs Traditional)
expr: Distortion = ABC Unit Cost − Traditional Unit Cost

name: Practical Capacity Rate
expr: Rate = Activity Cost/Practical Capacity of Driver

name: Unused Activity Capacity Cost
expr: Unused Capacity Cost = Rate × (Practical Capacity − Actual Usage)

name: TDABC Capacity Cost Rate
expr: Capacity Cost Rate = Cost of Capacity Supplied/Practical Capacity (minutes)

name: TDABC Activity Cost
expr: Activity Cost = Capacity Cost Rate × Time per Activity × Number of Activities

name: Batch-Level Cost per Unit
expr: Batch Cost per Unit = Cost per Batch/Units per Batch

name: Activity Cost Pool
expr: Cost Pool = Σ Costs of Resources Consumed by the Activity

name: Non-Value-Added Cost
expr: Non-Value-Added Cost = Total Activity Cost − Value-Added Cost

name: Relevant Cost of Material in Regular Use
expr: Relevant Cost = Current Replacement Cost

name: Relevant Cost of Material with No Other Use
expr: Relevant Cost = Higher of Net Scrap Value and Value in Alternative Use

name: Relevant Cost of Labour
expr: Relevant Cost = Wage Paid + Contribution Lost from Diverted Work

name: Make or Buy Rule
expr: Make if Relevant Variable Cost to Make < Purchase Price

name: Make or Buy with Limiting Factor
expr: Extra Cost of Buying per Scarce Unit = (Buy Price − Variable Cost to Make)/Scarce Resource per Unit

name: Special Order Rule
expr: Accept if Offer Price > Incremental Cost per Unit (when spare capacity exists)

name: Special Order Incremental Profit
expr: Incremental Profit = (Offer Price − Variable Cost) × Units − Additional Fixed Costs

name: Product Elimination Rule
expr: Drop Product if Product Contribution < Avoidable Fixed Costs

name: Limiting Factor Ranking
expr: Rank Products by Contribution per Unit of Scarce Resource

name: Opportunity Cost of Capital Employed
expr: Opportunity Cost = Funds Invested × Required Rate of Return

name: Differential Cost
expr: Differential Cost = Cost of Alternative A − Cost of Alternative B

name: Transfer Price (Spare Capacity)
expr: Minimum Transfer Price = Marginal Cost

name: Transfer Price (Full Capacity)
expr: Minimum Transfer Price = Marginal Cost + Contribution Lost on External Sale

name: Transfer Price (Cost Plus)
expr: Transfer Price = Full Cost × (1 + Markup %)

name: Divisional ROI
expr: Divisional ROI = (Divisional Profit/Divisional Investment) × 100

name: Target Selling Price
expr: Target Price = Target Cost + Target Profit

name: Passenger-Kilometres
expr: Passenger-km = Passengers Carried × Distance

name: Cost per Passenger-Kilometre
expr: Cost per Passenger-km = Total Operating Cost/Passenger-Kilometres

name: Absolute Tonne-Kilometre
expr: Absolute Tonne-km = Σ (Load in Tonnes × Distance Travelled)

name: Commercial Tonne-Kilometre
expr: Commercial Tonne-km = Average Load × Total Distance Covered

name: Cost per Tonne-Kilometre
expr: Cost per Tonne-km = Total Cost/Tonne-Kilometres

name: Transport Cost per Kilometre
expr: Cost per km = (Fixed Cost + Running Cost)/Total Kilometres

name: Vehicle Depreciation per Kilometre
expr: Depreciation per km = (Cost − Residual Value)/Estimated Life in km

name: Tyre Cost per Kilometre
expr: Tyre Cost per km = (Cost of Tyres − Resale Value)/Expected Life in km

name: Hotel Cost per Occupied Room-Night
expr: Cost per Room-Night = Total Cost/Room-Nights Occupied

name: Hotel Occupancy Rate
expr: Occupancy % = (Occupied Room-Nights/Available Room-Nights) × 100

name: Hospital Cost per Patient-Day
expr: Cost per Patient-day = Total Hospital Cost/Patient-Days

name: Bed Occupancy Percentage
expr: Bed Occupancy % = (Occupied Bed-Days/Available Bed-Days) × 100

name: Power Cost per kWh
expr: Cost per kWh = Total Generation Cost/Units (kWh) Generated

name: Electricity Units Sold
expr: Units Sold = Units Generated − Units Lost or Used Internally

name: Education Cost per Student
expr: Cost per Student = Total Cost/Number of Students

name: Cost per Available Seat-Kilometre
expr: CASK = Total Operating Cost/Available Seat-Kilometres

name: Cost-Plus Fare
expr: Fare = Cost per Passenger-km × Distance × (1 + Profit %)

name: Canteen Cost per Meal
expr: Cost per Meal = Total Canteen Cost/Meals Served

name: Steam Cost per 1000 kg
expr: Cost per 1000 kg Steam = Total Boiler Cost/(Steam Raised in kg/1000)

name: Break-even Passengers
expr: Break-even Passengers = Fixed Costs/(Fare − Variable Cost per Passenger)

name: Standing Charges per Day
expr: Standing Charges per Day = Annual Fixed Costs/Working Days

name: Vehicle Utilisation Percentage
expr: Utilisation % = (Kilometres Actually Run/Available Kilometres) × 100

name: Cost Reduction Percentage
expr: % Cost Reduction = ((Old Cost − New Cost)/Old Cost) × 100

name: Quality Cost Percentage
expr: Quality Cost % = (Total Quality Cost/Sales) × 100

name: Cost of Conformance
expr: Cost of Conformance = Prevention Cost + Appraisal Cost

name: Cost of Non-conformance
expr: Cost of Non-conformance = Internal Failure Cost + External Failure Cost

name: Total Cost of Quality
expr: COQ = Prevention + Appraisal + Internal Failure + External Failure

name: Learning Curve Cumulative Average Time
expr: Cumulative Average Time for 2n units = Learning Rate × Cumulative Average Time for n units

name: Learning Curve Exponent
expr: b = ln(Learning Rate)/ln 2

name: Learning Curve Total Time
expr: Total Time for n units = a × n^(1 + b)

name: Life Cycle Cost
expr: Life-cycle Cost = Pre-production + Production + After-sales + Disposal Cost

name: Kaizen Target Cost
expr: Target Cost after n Months = Current Cost × (1 − Monthly Reduction %)^n

name: Value Engineering Saving
expr: Saving = Original Cost − Value-Engineered Cost

name: Cost Efficiency Index
expr: Cost Efficiency = Standard Cost of Actual Output/Actual Cost

name: Cost per Rupee of Sales
expr: Cost per Rupee of Sales = Total Cost/Sales

name: Overhead to Sales Ratio
expr: Overhead Ratio % = (Overhead/Sales) × 100

name: Variance Investigation (Statistical)
expr: Investigate if |Variance| > k × σ, for example k = 2

name: Variance Investigation (Percentage)
expr: Investigate if |Variance|/Standard Cost > Threshold %

name: Variance Investigation (Cost-Benefit)
expr: Investigate if Probability of Out-of-Control × Savings from Correction > Cost of Investigation
